blurb: Guests can jump on trampolines, play laser tag in a multilevel maze, and enjoy arcade games. The facility offers birthday party packages with personal hosts and customizable options. Special socks are required for trampoline use and can be purchased on site.
extraNote: All prices plus tax, no refunds, prices subject to change · $200 non-refundable deposit required for birthday parties · Deposits non-refundable even if cancelled due to weather · Parties cancelled same day lose deposit · Prizes redeemed in store are final sale, no refund or exchange
